profile_text.body: Anyscale, founded in 2019 and based in San Francisco, California, helps AI builders run data-intensive workloads to build and deploy Foundation Models and AI at scale on any cloud. The company describes itself as powered by Ray and offers capabilities including orchestrating model training across GPU clusters with elastic scaling, last-mile data preprocessing, and GPU observability. According to the company's site, Anyscale enables teams to scale workloads seamlessly and move models from concept to production rapidly, with one example citing deployment in a single day compared to a week or more previously.
